header.title: Super Admin
header.description: See your SaaS at glance and manage all your resources in one place.

summary.users: The number of personal accounts that have been created.
summary.organizations: The number of organizations that have been created.
summary.customers: The number of customers for your SaaS.

header.title: Users
header.description: Manage your users and their roles.

ban.description: Ban this user from the platform. You can specify a reason and an optional expiration date for the ban.

reason.info: Enter the reason for banning the user.

expiresIn.info: Enter the expiration date for the ban or leave it blank for no expiration.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}
delete.disclaimer:
You are about to delete this user. 

After deleting it, all user data (including sessions and permissions) will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered. 

Do you want to continue?

update.title: Update {{name}}'s password
update.description: Make sure to choose a strong password that meets the security requirements. This action will immediately update the user's login credentials.
update.info: Enter the new password for the account.

header.title: Organizations
header.description: Manage your organizations and their members.

dataPolicy.open: No restrictions: every endpoint may serve this organization.
dataPolicy.nothingAllowed: No endpoint satisfies this policy: every request of this organization is refused.

topupFee.notePlaceholder: Why this organization pays a different fee
topupFee.cleared: The organization pays the default fee again.
topupFee.invalidPercent: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100 with at most two decimals, or leave it empty for the default.
topupFee.invalidMinimum: Enter an amount from 0 to 400 SAR with at most two decimals, or leave it empty for the default.
topupFee.invalidDate: Choose a date from today on, or leave it empty for no expiry.
topupFee.nothingSet: Set a fee or a minimum, or use Back to default.
topupFee.description: Higher or lower than the default, for this organization only. An empty field uses the default's value. From the day after the last valid day the default applies again by itself. Every change is kept with its value before and after.

rateLimit.invalid: Enter a whole number above 0, or leave it empty for no limit.
rateLimit.description: Applies to all the organization's keys together. Requests over it are refused with 429 before reaching a provider, and are not charged. Leave both empty to remove the limit. With more than one gateway instance, each instance counts on its own.

amount.label: Amount
amount.invalid: Enter a non-zero amount, up to 1,000,000. Negative removes credit.

credits.description: Positive adds credit, negative removes it. The adjustment is a ledger entry with your name and reason, and appears in the audit log.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}
delete.disclaimer:
You are about to delete this organization. 

After deleting it, all organization data (including members and teams) will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered. 

Do you want to continue?

header.title: Customers
header.description: Manage your customers and their subscriptions.

updatePlan.title: Update {{name}}'s plan
updatePlan.description: Pick a plan and a status for the customer. This action will immediately update the customer's plan and status.`

plan.info: The plan determines the features and pricing for the customer.

status.info: The status determines the subscription status for the customer.

error.cannotUpdateUsersPassword: You cannot update a user's password via update user.

header.title: Pricing
header.description: Set the fee added to top-ups, the top-up limits and the USD to SAR rate. Requests are charged at the provider's cost, converted at that rate.

pricing.saved: Prices saved. Gateways apply them within 30 seconds.

error.maxBelowMin: The maximum must be at least the minimum.
error.presets: Enter 1 to {{count}} amounts above zero, in riyals and halalas, separated by commas.
error.presetOutOfRange: Each quick pick must be between the minimum and the maximum.

settings.title: Top-up fee, limits and exchange rate
settings.description: Rates are percentages. Changes reach the gateway within 30 seconds and apply to requests that start after that.

topupFee.label: Top-up fee
topupFee.description: Added to the payment when a customer buys credits, but never less than the minimum. It is never taken from their credits.

topupFeeMin.label: Minimum top-up fee
topupFeeMin.description: The least fee a top-up pays, in riyals: the fee is the larger of the percentage and this amount. OpenRouter charges 5.5% with a $0.80 minimum.

topupMin.label: Minimum top-up
topupMin.description: The least credit a customer can buy in one payment, in riyals.

topupMax.label: Maximum top-up
topupMax.description: The most credit a customer can buy in one payment, in riyals.

topupPresets.label: Quick picks
topupPresets.description: Amounts offered as buttons on the top-up form, in riyals, separated by commas: 1 to {{count}}, each within the limits.

usdToSarRate.label: USD to SAR rate
usdToSarRate.description: The official rate, set by hand and never fetched: 3.75 is the peg. Provider costs are in USD and each request is converted once, when it is held and charged. A change applies to new requests only; past charges keep the rate they were made at.

fxSpread.label: Bank spread
fxSpread.description: The bank's commission on converting USD to SAR, added to the official rate. 0% uses the official rate as it is.

effectiveRate.label: Rate new requests use
effectiveRate.description: The official rate plus the spread, rounded up to the millionth. Every hold and charge records the official rate, the spread and this rate.

creditTerms.title: Refunds and credit expiry
creditTerms.description: How long after a top-up its unused credit can be refunded from the credits page, and when credit expires. Each purchase keeps the terms it was bought on: a change applies to purchases made after it.

refundWindow.label: Refund window
refundWindow.description: 0 switches self-serve refunds off at once, for every purchase. The fee is never refunded.

expiry.label: Credit expires after
expiry.description: Counted from each purchase. Promo credit expires on its code's own date when it has one. Turn the switch off for credit that never expires.

error.range: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

changes.title: Change history
changes.description: Every change to these prices, newest first. It cannot be edited.
changes.retired: A setting that no longer exists

header.title: Audit log
header.description: Every change staff made in this console, newest first. It cannot be edited or deleted.

header.title: Providers
header.description: Every provider key in the gateway, with what we know about where it processes data, how long it keeps it and whether it trains on it. A data policy relies only on what is recorded here: anything unknown counts as kept and trained on.

providers.unavailable: The gateway could not be reached, so its provider keys cannot be listed.
providers.empty: The gateway has no provider keys yet. Add a provider in the gateway first.
providers.noTerms: Nothing recorded: treated as kept and trained on
providers.removed: Data terms removed. The key is unknown again.

form.title: Data terms for {{key}} ({{provider}})
form.description: Record only what an agreement or the provider's published terms say, and where it says so.

retention.label: Retention in days
retention.description: 0 if nothing is kept. Leave empty if unknown.

source.label: Source
source.placeholder: A link or a contract reference

form.gone: This key is no longer in the gateway. Its terms can only be removed.

accounts.title: Providers and keys
accounts.description: The providers the gateway can call and the keys it calls them with. A key's value is typed once and never shown again.
accounts.noKeys: No key yet: requests to this provider will fail until it has one.
accounts.name: Name, for example openai
accounts.baseUrl: Address, only for a provider of our own
accounts.addHint: Leave the address empty for a provider the gateway knows by name. With an address, the name is ours to choose and the provider must speak the OpenAI protocol.

error.exists: A provider with this name already exists.
error.refused: The gateway refused this change. Check the name and the address.

accounts.syncPricesHint: The gateway reads provider prices on a schedule. Use this after a provider changes its prices and you do not want to wait.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Each day, the provider cost the gateway logged is compared with the provider cost the ledger recorded, per organization. A difference, a cost no organization owns, or a hold released without its charge is listed here.

email.subject: Reconciliation needs a look
email.preview: The gateway and the ledger differ for {{period}}
email.mismatch: The daily reconciliation for {{period}} (UTC) found differences between what the gateway logged and what the ledger charged.
email.error: The daily reconciliation for {{period}} (UTC) could not read one of its sources.
email.counts: Organizations differing: {{organizations}}. Charges lost to reaped holds: {{reapedHolds}}. Unattributed costs: {{unattributed}}.

header.title: Requests
header.description: Every request the gateway logged, newest first, failed ones included. It shows what happened to a request, never the prompt or the answer.

requests.unavailable: The request log is not available right now.

header.title: Payments
header.description: The payment gateways that take top-ups: which one is active, its mode, and whether customers can add credits.

topups.title: Top-ups
topups.description: When off, customers cannot start a new top-up and see that top-ups are paused. Payments already started are still credited.
topups.label: Top-ups enabled
topups.unavailable: Customers cannot top up right now: {{reason}}

reason.secrets: the active provider has no {{mode}} secrets in env.

providers.title: Payment providers
providers.description: Secrets stay in the server's environment: this page shows only whether each one is set, never its value. Changes apply within 30 seconds.
providers.webhookUrlDescription: Add this endpoint in the provider's dashboard, in each mode you use, with the events listed in ADR 0012.

secret.wrongMode: Wrong mode: a key of the other mode

live.title: Switch to live mode?
live.description: In live mode every top-up charges a real card and adds credits customers can spend. Make sure the live secrets and the live webhook endpoint are set in the provider's dashboard.

payments.saved: Payment settings saved. They apply within 30 seconds.

error.providerDisabled: This provider is disabled. Enable it before making it active.
error.providerNotConfigured: This provider's secrets for its current mode are missing from the server's environment. Set them before making it active.
error.secretsMissing: The secrets for this mode are missing from the server's environment, or are keys of the other mode. Set them before switching.
error.activeProviderDisabled: This is the active provider. Make another provider active before disabling it.

changes.title: Change history
changes.description: Every change to these settings, newest first. It cannot be edited.

header.title: Promo codes
header.description: Codes customers enter to take something off the top-up fee, get bonus credit on a top-up, or receive free credit. Every change is kept with its values before and after.

form.codeDescription: Letters, digits, - and _, 3 to 32 long. Customers can type it in any case.
form.kindLocked: This code has been used: its kind cannot change.
form.creditExpiresAtDescription: Optional. Without a date, the credit expires like purchased credit.
form.organizationIdsDescription: One organization ID per line, from the organizations page.
form.notePlaceholder: Why this code exists, for the next person who reads it
form.invalidPercent: Enter a percentage above 0 and at most 100, with up to two decimals.
form.invalidAmount: Enter an amount above 0, in riyals and halalas.
form.invalidUses: Enter a whole number above 0, or leave it empty.
form.invalidDates: The end must be after the start.
form.invalidCreditExpiry: The credit must last at least until the code ends.
form.noOrganizations: List at least one organization, or choose all organizations.

report.title: Report
report.description: Credit granted, clawed back and fee waived are read from the credits ledger. When a top-up is refunded, the unused part of its bonus is taken back: granted less clawed back is what the code left with organizations.

header.title: Model prices
header.description: Our price for each model at each provider, and at provider keys with a negotiated rate, in USD as providers price. Customers are charged these, converted at the effective rate, with no markup. A price is never edited: a new version takes over from the time it starts.

list.empty: No prices match. Import the gateway's current prices to start.

history.description: Every version of this model's price, its keys' included. None is ever changed; the one in force at a time is the latest that had started.
history.removed: Key price removed: the provider's price applies

form.description: Saving adds a version; the current one stays in the history. Leave a rate empty if the model has none.
form.keyHint: A key's price is its whole price: the gateway does not combine it with the provider's, so it must set every rate the provider's price sets.
form.remove: End this key's own price (the provider's price applies again)
form.fromHint: Empty: now. A price cannot start in the past.
form.otherRatesHint: USD per unit, by the gateway's field name, for example output_cost_per_image or input_cost_per_second.

suggestions.description: Prices the gateway's datasheet proposes where they differ from ours. Nothing changes until someone approves; a price set by staff always wins.
suggestions.approved: Suggestion approved: a new version is in force
suggestions.rejected: Suggestion rejected: the price is unchanged

check.description: Compares the gateway's pricing overrides and catalog with our prices.
check.clean: The gateway charges exactly our prices.

header.title: Key defaults
header.description: What a new API key starts from, and how long any key may live.

keySettings.savedShortened: Key defaults saved. {{count}} existing keys now expire at the new maximum.

form.title: Defaults for new keys
form.description: The create form starts from these values; the customer can change them, within the maximum lifetime.

defaultLimit.label: Default credit limit
defaultLimit.description: In riyals. Leave empty for no limit by default.
defaultLimit.invalid: Enter an amount above 0, up to 4,000,000, with at most two decimals.

defaultReset.label: Default reset
defaultReset.description: Needs a default limit. Daily at midnight UTC, weekly on Monday, monthly on the 1st.

defaultExpiry.label: Default expiration
defaultExpiry.description: Preselected in the create form. It must be within the maximum lifetime.

maxLifetime.label: Maximum key lifetime
maxLifetime.description: No key may live longer, counted from its creation. A shorter maximum also cuts existing keys: each expires at its creation plus the maximum, or within seconds if that has passed. Raising it later extends no key.

presets.label: Limit quick picks
presets.description: Amounts offered in the create form, in riyals, separated by commas: 1 to {{count}}.
presets.invalid: Enter 1 to {{count}} amounts above zero, in riyals and halalas, separated by commas.

form.defaultBeyondMax: The default expiration must be within the maximum lifetime.

changes.title: History
changes.description: Every change of the key defaults, with who made it and the values before and after.

header.title: Account limits
header.description: How many organizations one user may own, and the waits on moving credit to an organization.

limit.title: Organizations per user
limit.description: The most organizations one user may own. A personal account is not counted, and neither are organizations they are only a member of.
limit.label: Organizations a user may own
limit.invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1,000.
limit.help: Applies to everyone without a limit of their own. Nobody loses an organization they already own: the limit is checked when one is created. To allow one customer more, open the user and set their own limit.

user.title: Organization limit
user.help: Set a number to allow this user more or fewer organizations than the general limit. Leave it empty to follow the general limit.

transfers.title: Credit transfers
transfers.description: A user can move credit they bought from their personal account to an organization they belong to. These two waits slow down misuse, such as moving credit bought with a stolen card.
transfers.invalid: Enter a whole number of hours from 0 to 8,760.

transferMemberTenureHours.label: A new member waits
transferMemberTenureHours.help: How long someone must have been a member before the organization can receive their credit. 0: at once.

transferCooldownHours.label: Between two transfers
transferCooldownHours.help: How long an organization waits after receiving a transfer before it can receive the next. 0: no wait.

header.title: Catalog figures
header.description: What a model page's figures need before they are shown, and whether traffic volume is public.

minCalls.title: Least data for a figure
minCalls.description: A latency, throughput, uptime or price-paid figure is shown on a model page only when at least this many answered requests are behind it. Below it the page says there is not enough data.
minCalls.label: Answered requests needed
minCalls.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000.
minCalls.help: A figure from a handful of requests misleads: one slow request would read as a slow model. Raise it as traffic grows.

traffic.title: Traffic volume
traffic.description: Whether visitors see how many tokens each model served per day and each endpoint's share of them. It shows how much the platform is used.
traffic.label: Show traffic volume on model pages
